lessons.key: ac_gap::a range bound min period min size needs a test on the far side of the bound not only inside it below the minimum detection must fail not return a multiple
lessons.text: A range bound (min period, min size) needs a test on the far side of the bound, not only inside it: below the minimum, detection must fail, not return a multiple.

lessons.key: weak_test::a criterion that names a screen element message plus button is proven by an e2e that drives the state and clicks the control not by asserting the client status
lessons.text: A criterion that names a screen element (message plus button) is proven by an e2e that drives the state and clicks the control, not by asserting the client status.

lessons.key: ac_gap::every input mode a criterion lists middle button and space gets its own test and modifier key gestures must be excluded from the other tools handlers
lessons.text: Every input mode a criterion lists (middle button and Space) gets its own test, and modifier-key gestures must be excluded from the other tools' handlers.

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::state whether a numeric limit applies per item or to the total e g modifier sum of constants when writing the criterion
lessons.text: State whether a numeric limit applies per item or to the total (e.g. modifier = sum of constants) when writing the criterion.

lessons.key: ac_gap::text length limits count characters s length never utf 16 units and the tests include an emoji at the boundary
lessons.text: Text length limits count characters ([...s].length), never UTF-16 units, and the tests include an emoji at the boundary.

lessons.key: weak_test::a value a third party tool fills in release name artifact name is asserted from the tool s own output or parser not from our config because the tool s default may differ from the spec
lessons.text: A value a third-party tool fills in (release name, artifact name) is asserted from the tool's own output or parser, not from our config, because the tool's default may differ from the spec.

lessons.key: weak_test::when test mode swaps a dependency the line that chooses between real and fake gets its own test through the real wiring or a wrong choice stays green in every test
lessons.text: When test mode swaps a dependency, the line that chooses between real and fake gets its own test through the real wiring, or a wrong choice stays green in every test.

lessons.key: weak_test::a claim about every item all commits all rows is proven against the full source list never by sampling two members
lessons.text: A claim about 'every' item (all commits, all rows) is proven against the full source list, never by sampling two members.

lessons.key: weak_test::a ci step s arguments are tested with the shell that runs them pwsh on windows runners drops and does not expand var and a publish step is tested against the tool s behaviour when nothing exists yet
lessons.text: A CI step's arguments are tested with the shell that runs them (pwsh on Windows runners drops '--' and does not expand $VAR), and a publish step is tested against the tool's behaviour when nothing exists yet.

lessons.key: weak_test::a rule about any element is tested with the hit at the first a middle and the last position so a check of only one position fails
lessons.text: A rule about 'any' element is tested with the hit at the first, a middle and the last position, so a check of only one position fails.

lessons.key: ac_gap::a wire schema s size cap sits above the domain limit so the domain s refusal message is reachable test the limit through the parser not only the reducer
lessons.text: A wire schema's size cap sits above the domain limit, so the domain's refusal message is reachable; test the limit through the parser, not only the reducer.

lessons.key: gate_fail::exercise a renderer at the spec s upper bound here 2000 fog shapes redrawing everything per change crashed the window draw only what was added
lessons.text: Exercise a renderer at the spec's upper bound (here 2000 fog shapes): redrawing everything per change crashed the window; draw only what was added.

lessons.key: weak_test::when the model and the drawing implement the same geometry test the case where common implementations differ a self crossing polygon even odd vs nonzero
lessons.text: When the model and the drawing implement the same geometry, test the case where common implementations differ (a self-crossing polygon: even-odd vs nonzero).

lessons.key: weak_test::a test hook for something drawn measures the drawn geometry or pixels through the real transform never the tool s own state
lessons.text: A test hook for something drawn measures the drawn geometry or pixels through the real transform, never the tool's own state.

lessons.key: weak_test::position and draw order in a test hook come from the drawn objects bounds real child order not from the container fields the code sets
lessons.text: Position and draw order in a test hook come from the drawn objects (bounds, real child order), not from the container fields the code sets.

lessons.key: ac_gap::every new pointer or key gesture states which tool and state it works in select tool no space and how it ends empty click esc tool change
lessons.text: Every new pointer or key gesture states which tool and state it works in (select tool, no Space) and how it ends (empty click, Esc, tool change).

lessons.key: ac_gap::when an item can rotate every geometric rule on it snap bounds hit uses the rotated box
lessons.text: When an item can rotate, every geometric rule on it (snap, bounds, hit) uses the rotated box.

lessons.key: weak_test::a test of kept separate writes both sides and reads both back a test of a filter feeds it a real readable input it must reject
lessons.text: A test of 'kept separate' writes both sides and reads both back; a test of a filter feeds it a real, readable input it must reject.

lessons.key: ac_gap::keyboard shortcuts and clickable toolbars are tested with the focus where a user leaves it in the toolbar s own field and on the button just clicked space enter re press it
lessons.text: Keyboard shortcuts and clickable toolbars are tested with the focus where a user leaves it: in the toolbar's own field, and on the button just clicked (Space/Enter re-press it).

lessons.key: weak_test::a check s proof is the test at the layer that does the thing the service that loads the e2e that sees nothing created not the pure helper it calls
lessons.text: A check's proof is the test at the layer that does the thing (the service that loads, the e2e that sees nothing created), not the pure helper it calls.

lessons.key: weak_test::a time limit in a criterion is the test s timeout exactly measured with the app s real delays never a rounded up margin
lessons.text: A time limit in a criterion is the test's timeout exactly, measured with the app's real delays, never a rounded-up margin.

lessons.key: weak_test::every part a test title names token and object grid detected gets its own assertion a title is not evidence
lessons.text: Every part a test title names (token and object, grid detected) gets its own assertion; a title is not evidence.

lessons.key: gate_fail::parallel e2e workers take ports from disjoint blocks below the ephemeral range a port freed by the os picker can be taken before the app binds it
lessons.text: Parallel e2e workers take ports from disjoint blocks below the ephemeral range; a port freed by the OS picker can be taken before the app binds it.

lessons.key: gate_fail::client side optimistic state lives until the view shows it not until the ack because the server acks before it broadcasts the patch
lessons.text: Client-side optimistic state lives until the view shows it, not until the ack, because the server acks before it broadcasts the patch.

lessons.key: weak_test::a timed transition a 2 s fade is proven by sampling its value midway through in the real app never by a state flag a timer keeps
lessons.text: A timed transition (a 2 s fade) is proven by sampling its value midway through in the real app, never by a state flag a timer keeps.

lessons.key: weak_test::a volume or filter claim is read from what leaves the processing graph a meter on the output not from the setting s own node
lessons.text: A volume or filter claim is read from what leaves the processing graph (a meter on the output), not from the setting's own node.

lessons.key: weak_test::anything that compensates for another computer clock offset is tested with that difference simulated two windows on one machine share it
lessons.text: Anything that compensates for another computer (clock offset) is tested with that difference simulated; two windows on one machine share it.

lessons.key: ac_gap::async loads that race with state changes are tested in every order off before the file arrives then on again during the fade
lessons.text: Async loads that race with state changes are tested in every order: off before the file arrives, then on again during the fade.

lessons.key: weak_test::overlapping or concurrent is asserted as both alive at the same instant not as both having happened
lessons.text: 'Overlapping' or 'concurrent' is asserted as both alive at the same instant, not as both having happened.
